jobs.title: Sr. Spclst , Technical Product Management
jobs.description:
Job Description
  
  

Sr. Spclst , Technical Product Management
  
  

The Opportunity
  
  

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130\- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organization driven by digital technology and data\-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision\-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the worlds greatest health threats.


Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  

A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well\-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  

**Role Overview:**  

* Prioritizes product requirements, develops product roadmaps and owns the product backlog. Analyses market and/or user research, feedback, expert opinion and usage data to understand needs and opportunities. Facilitates uptake of products by developing content, supporting and evaluating campaigns, and monitoring product performance. Rolls out product trials and product launches.
* Defines and manages scoping, requirements definition and prioritization activities for changes. Provides constructive challenge to stakeholders as required. Reviews requirements for errors and omissions. Prioritizes requirements and documents traceability to source. Provides input to the requirements baseline. Investigates, manages and applies authorized requests for changes to base\-line requirements.
* Stakeholder Relationships: Deals with problems and issues, managing resolutions, corrective actions, lessons learned, and the collection and dissemination of relevant information. Implements stakeholder engagement/communications plan. Collects and uses feedback from customers and stakeholders to help measure the effectiveness of stakeholder management. Helps develop and enhance customer and stakeholder relationships.
* User Experience Analysis: Selects appropriate techniques and tools to develop user stories and elicit user experience requirements in complex situations. Identifies and describes the design goals for systems, products, services and devices. Identifies the roles of affected stakeholder groups. Resolves potential conflicts between differing user requirements. Specifies measurable criteria for the required usability and accessibility of systems, products, services and devices.
* Collaboration: Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define and execute product strategies that align with business goals and enhance the risk ecosystem. Analyze existing processes and workflows to identify areas for improvement, ensuring efficiency and effectiveness in product delivery. Work closely with stakeholders, including business leaders, technical teams, and end\-users, to gather requirements and translate them into actionable product features.
* Value Realization: Collaborate with the Product Manager, Technical Product Manager, and stakeholders to implement new products/projects, ensuring adherence to project objectives/timelines and maximizing adoption/value creation.
* Participate in the design and architecture of the systems, ensuring scalability, performance, and security. Create and maintain technical documentation, including system designs, requirements specifications, test plans, and user guides. Assist with Digital System Development Life\-Cycle (SDLC), Author, Execution, Reviewer/Approver, and Change Management.
* Develop and execute comprehensive testing strategies, including functional, integration, and regression testing, to ensure quality and reliability.
* Provide training and support to users and stakeholders on new product features and enhancements.


Who we are
  
We are known as Merck Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the worlds most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
  
  

What we look for
  
Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.
  
  

**Required Skills:**  

Asset Management, Benefits Management, Corrective Action Management, Create User Stories, Digital Development, Management System Development, Product Backlog Management, Product Management, Product Offerings, Product Strategies, Requirements Management, Stakeholder Analysi…

jobs.description:
### **Summary**

\#LI\-Hybrid  

  

Location: Hyderabad, India  

  

About this Role:  

As Manager, Competitive Intelligence (CI), Technical Research \& Development (TRD), you will play a key role in establishing and driving the TRD Competitive Intelligence framework to support innovation, product differentiation, and technology\-driven decision making across the Novartis development portfolio. This role will partner with TRD leadership and scientific stakeholders to transform external scientific, competitive, technological, regulatory, and product intelligence into actionable insights that influence product design, drug delivery strategies, device innovation, lifecycle management, and emerging technology adoption.
### **About the Role**

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Partner with TRD stakeholders to identify intelligence priorities and deliver actionable insights that support product development, innovation, and portfolio decisions. Continuously enhance knowledge repositories, monitoring frameworks, and intelligence processes to support evolving business needs.
* Lead competitive and technology intelligence activities across Small Molecules, Biologics, xRNA, Cell \& Gene Therapy (CGT), Radioligand Therapy (RLT), Drug Delivery, and Device Technologies.
* Monitor and assess competitor product design strategies, delivery technologies, dosage forms, medical devices, lifecycle management activities, and emerging scientific innovations.
* Conduct technology landscaping, benchmarking, and scouting to identify opportunities for differentiation, innovation, and external collaboration.
* Develop high\-impact deliverables including technology assessments, competitor profiles, executive briefings, technology landscapes, conference reports, and strategic recommendations.
* Serve as a subject matter expert on competitive intelligence methodologies, scientific intelligence gathering, technology scouting, and external benchmarking.
* Collaborate with PHAD, GDPD, Product Design Excellence, TRD Biologics, CGT, RLT, ARD, Innovation, Scientific Office, and DDIT teams.
* Influence decision\-making through clear communication, compelling narratives, and executive\-level storytelling.
* Leverage scientific, patent, competitive intelligence, and commercial databases to generate evidence\-based insights and recommendations.
* Drive adoption of AI\-enabled tools, automation, and innovative intelligence approaches.
* Manage and mentor analysts while ensuring high\-quality deliverables and capability development.

**Essential Requirements**
--------------------------

* Advanced degree in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biomedical Sciences, Chemical Engineering or related scientific discipline.
* 8\+ years of experience in Competitive Intelligence, Scientific Intelligence, Technical Development, Pharmaceutical R\&D, Product Development, CMC, Consulting or related functions.
* Demonstrated experience supporting strategic decision\-making through competitive intelligence, technology assessment, benchmarking or innovation scouting.
* Strong understanding of pharmaceutical databases including AlphaSense, Citeline, Cortellis, BioMedTracker, PharmaCircle, IQVIA and Evaluate.
* Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders and lead complex projects in a matrix organization.

**Desirable Requirements:**
---------------------------

* PhD in pharmaceutical technology or formulation technology.
* Strong understanding of CMC, product development or drug delivery experience

**Why Novartis:** Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people\-and\-culture

**Benefits and Rewards:** Learn about all the ways we’ll help you thrive personally and professionally.  

Read our handbook (PDF 30 MB)

jobs.description:
About Us

We are a growing women's fashion label based in Hyderabad with two distinct brand lines — couture pret \& ethnic wear, and casuals \& semi\-casuals. We are building something exciting from the ground up and looking for our very first team member to grow with us.

About the Role

This is a high\-ownership, all\-in\-one role where you will work directly with the founder across brand, marketing, operations, and sales. No two days will look the same. If you love fashion, are highly organised, and want real exposure to how a fashion business is built — this role is for you.

Results\-driven Social Media Manager with **5 years of experience** managing digital marketing and social media for a clothing brand. Skilled in content strategy, influencer marketing, paid advertising, community management, and analytics. Proven ability to grow brand presence, increase engagement, and drive online sales through creative and data\-driven campaigns.

What You'll Do

* Managed end\-to\-end social media strategy across Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest, and TikTok, driving brand awareness and customer engagement.
* Created and executed monthly content calendars aligned with seasonal collections, product launches, and marketing campaigns.
* Planned and produced engaging content, including reels, photoshoots, stylingvideos, and influencer collaborations.
* Increased follower growth, engagement rates, and website traffic through data\-driven social media campaigns.
* Managed paid social media advertising campaigns to boost product visibility and online sales.
* Collaborated with designers, photographers, and marketing teams to maintain a consistent brand identity.
* Monitored social media analytics, tracked KPIs, and optimized content based on performance insights.
* Responded to customer inquiries and built an active online community, improving customer satisfaction and brand loyalty.
* Stayed updated with fashion trends and social media best practices to keep the brand competitive.
* Successfully managed multiple campaigns, contributing to increased sales and strong customer engagement over a **5\-year** period.
* Support brand building and creative direction for both label lines
* Manage Instagram and social media content, reels, and campaigns
* Coordinate with vendors, tailors, and fabric suppliers
* Handle customer queries via WhatsApp, DMs, and email
* Assist with photoshoots, lookbooks, and influencer outreach
* Manage the founder's calendar, communications, and follow\-ups
* Maintain inventory trackers, order status, and dispatch coordination
* Support pop\-up events, trunk shows, and exhibitions

What We're Looking For

* min 3 years of experience in fashion, retail, or a startup
* Passion for women's fashion and styling
* Proficient in Instagram, Canva, Google Sheets, and WhatsApp Business
* Strong communication skills in English and Telugu/Hindi
* Self\-driven, organised, and comfortable multitasking
* Creative eye with a feel for brand aesthetics

Good to Have

* Knowledge of western, ethnic wear or couture pret market
* Basic skills in photo editing tools, content creation, photoshoots, etc

What You Get

* Direct mentorship from the founder
* Real ownership and fast\-track growth as the brand scales
* Creative freedom and a voice in brand decisions
* To Apply

Send your CV and a short note on why this role excites you. Bonus points if you share your Instagram or any creative work you're proud of.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

* Build a high\-accountability operating culture: clear OKRs, transparent tracking, and fast

* Strong analytical foundation — comfortable building business cases, reading dashboards, and designing pricing models.
* Ability to influence without authority: works across product, marketing, ops, and finance to drive outcomes.

jobs.description:
**Position Overview**
 Anaqua is expanding its development capability in Hyderabad to support and accelerate the evolution of the RightHub platform. We are looking for a strong, delivery\-focused Product Owner to work locally with the Hyderabad engineering team and act as the day\-to\-day product partner for development squads building and enhancing the RightHub platform.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who can bridge product strategy and engineering execution. The Product Owner will translate product direction, customer needs, roadmap priorities, and platform requirements into clear, actionable backlog items for the engineering team. They will work closely with global Product Managers and Product Leadership to ensure the Hyderabad team understands not only what needs to be built, but why it matters.
   

  

 Experience in intellectual property management software, legal technology, SaaS, enterprise software, or workflow\-heavy platforms is highly valuable, but not required. More important is the ability to learn a complex domain, communicate clearly, manage detail, and help engineering teams deliver high\-quality software. Proficiency in AI automation using agents is a big plus.
   

  

**You’ll Love This Job If You Enjoy**
 Product Ownership and Backlog Management
   

  

* Own and manage the product backlog for one or more RightHub engineering squads in Hyderabad.
* Translate roadmap priorities, product requirements, customer needs, and stakeholder input into well\-structured user stories, acceptance criteria, workflows, and supporting documentation.
* Ensure backlog items are clear, refined, prioritized, and ready for development.
* Work with Product Managers and Product Leadership to understand strategic priorities and convert them into executable delivery plans.
* Balance new feature development, technical improvements, customer commitments, defects, and platform modernization work.


 Working Closely with Engineering
   

  

* Serve as the primary local product contact for developers, QA engineers, architects, and technical leads.
* Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand\-ups where appropriate, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Clarify requirements quickly and remove product\-related blockers for the development team.
* Support engineering in making sensible trade\-offs between customer value, usability, technical feasibility, scalability, and delivery timelines.

**About The Role:** 




 We are looking for a strategic, commercially minded Product Manager with strong technical intuition with 5\+ years of experience building cloud\-native, scalable Enterprise SaaS products from the ground up (0 → 1\). You will own the end\-to\-end product lifecycle from discovery through launch, growth, and maturity for an API\-first platform that helps enterprises solve high\-stakes problems in fraud prevention, identity verification, and customer authentication.
 



 This role sits at the intersection of telecom infrastructure, identity \& security, and enterprise SaaS. You will translate complex operator\-network capabilities into compelling, developer\-friendly API products that help enterprises fight fraud, streamline authentication, and build trust with their customers. You should be someone who has lived through at least one full product lifecycle from MVP to Scale (or Sunset) and thrives in ambiguity, cross\-functional collaboration, and ecosystem\-level strategic thinking.
 



  





**What you’ll be Responsible for:** 



* **Product Strategy \& Roadmap** 
 : Define and drive product strategy, vision, and roadmap for our Enterprise API products. Position our APIs within the broader enterprise fraud\-prevention and identity stack to maximize relevance and stickiness. Define and drive product strategy, vision, and roadmap for Network API products aligned with GSMA Open Gateway and CAMARA API standards.
* **Strategic Discovery \& Ecosystem Thinking** 
 : Conduct deep strategic discovery, customer interviews, competitive intelligence, TAM/SAM analysis, and ecosystem mapping. Think beyond a single API, position the product within the broader enterprise fraud\-prevention and identity stack.
* **Product Metric Ownership** 
 : Own product KPIs end\-to\-end: adoption rates, API call volumes, latency SLAs, conversion funnels, revenue contribution, and customer NPS. Build dashboards using analytics tools, define success metrics, and hold the team accountable to them.
* **Agile Leadership \& Delivery** 
 : Lead agile squads (engineering, design, QA) through sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release management. Ensure predictable, high\-quality delivery cadence and clear acceptable criteria.
* **AI\-Enabled Development Lifecycle** 
 : Evaluate and integrate AI/ML\-enabled tools into the development lifecycle from automated testing and code review to intelligent API monitoring and anomaly detection.
* **Go\-to\-Market \& Stakeholder Management** 
 : Partner with Sales, Pre\-Sales, Customer Success, and BD teams to build sales enablement collateral, conduct product demos, and support enterprise deal cycles.
* **Product\-Led Growth (PLG)** 
 : Drive Product\-Led Growth motions: self\-serve onboarding, developer sandbox, usage\-based trials, and in\-product analytics to reduce sales\-cycle friction and accelerate adoption.
* **Developer \& Enterprise UX:** 
 Work closely with UX/Design to deliver intuitive developer portals, API documentation, and integration guides. Ensure the product experience delights both enterprise decision\-makers and integration engineers.
* **Cloud\-Native Fluency:** 
 Collaborate with engineering to ensure cloud\-native architecture best practices, microservices, containerization (Kubernetes), CI/CD, observability, and auto\-scaling are reflected in product decisions.



  





  





**What should We look in you?** 




  





**Must Have Qualifications** 



* 5\+ years of product management experience building cloud\-native, API\-first, or Enterprise SaaS products.
* Should have BE / B.Tech \& MBA be from Tier 1 institutes
* Demonstrated experience taking a product from 0 → 1 (ideation through launch and scale).
* Lived through at least one complete product lifecycle: MVP → Product\-Market Fit → Scale (or managed a graceful Sunset).
* Hands\-on experience with strategic discovery: customer interviews, TAM/SAM analysis, competitive intelligence, and ecosystem mapping.
* Proficiency in Agile/Scrum methodologies; experience as a Product Owner or equivalent.
* Track record of owning and improving product metrics (adoption, engagement, revenue).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to influence without authority across engineering, design and sales.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field. MBA or equivalent is a plus.



**Nice\-to\-Have** 



* Domain experience in telecom, identity, or fraud\-prevention ecosystems including familiarity with GSMA Open Gateway framework and CAMARA API specifications.
* Understanding of identity standards: OpenID Connect, CIBA, OAuth 2\.0
* Solid understanding of cloud\-native architecture: microservices, Kubernetes, API gateways, event\-driven patterns, observability.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled tooling in development workflows



  





**Why join us?** 



* **Impactful Work:** 
 Play a pivotal role in safeguarding Tanla's assets, data, and reputation in the industry.
* **Tremendous Growth Opportunities** 
 : Be part of a rapidly growing company in the telecom and CPaaS space, with opportunities for professional development.

 what youll do

**About Teradata**


At Teradata, we believe people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata’s Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge, and business context to deliver tangible business outcomes. Our platform enables organizations to provide AI agents with the full context needed to drive meaningful impact when it matters most. Teradata solutions seamlessly scale across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments, helping customers unlock real business value through AI.


**What You'll Do**
------------------


As a Software Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and enhancing cloud\-native data protection solutions. Your responsibilities will include:


* Understanding business and technical requirements and implementing software solutions aligned with product architecture and design.
* Enhancing the Enterprise Data Protection (EDP) platform to support a growing ecosystem across public cloud providers, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Designing, developing, and maintaining scalable backend services using Java and modern software engineering practices.
* Writing comprehensive unit and integration tests to ensure code quality and reliability.
* Ensuring software deployments meet functional, performance, and quality requirements before release.
* Collaborating closely with developers, architects, QA engineers, and product owners to deliver high\-quality features on schedule.
* Participating in code reviews, troubleshooting, debugging, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**About the Team**
------------------


The Enterprise Data Protection (EDP) team develops Teradata’s comprehensive data protection and migration solutions designed to support customers on their journey to the Autonomous Knowledge Platform.


Built on a modern microservices architecture, EDP delivers secure, reliable, and efficient data migration capabilities while also providing critical assessment, validation, monitoring, and error\-detection features. The platform helps ensure a seamless and trusted data protection experience for enterprise customers operating across multiple cloud environments.


**What Makes You a Strong Candidate**
-------------------------------------


### **Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in software design, development, and delivery of enterprise applications.
* Strong programming skills in Java, including data structures, algorithms, object\-oriented design, and complexity analysis.
* Solid understanding of relational database management systems (RDBMS) and SQL.
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting experience in Linux environments.
* Hands\-on experience developing microservices and containerized applications using Docker.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and knowledge\-sharing skills.
* Experience using AI\-powered development tools for code generation, review, and productivity enhancement.

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Working knowledge of Linux, SQL, Git, and Jira.
* Experience with one or more public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and modern software development methodologies.
* Knowledge of Teradata databases or other enterprise\-grade RDBMS platforms.
* Exposure to cloud\-native applications, distributed systems, and scalable architecture patterns.

 T\-Mobile US, Inc. (NASDAQ: TMUS), headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, is America’s supercharged Un\-carrier, connecting millions through its strong nationwide network and flagship brands, T\-Mobile and Metro by T\-Mobile. Customers benefit from an unmatched combination of value, quality, and exceptional service experience.
 



  





**TMUS Global Solutions:** 




 TMUS Global Solutions is a world\-class technology powerhouse accelerating the company’s global digital transformation. With a culture built on growth, inclusivity, and global collaboration, the teams here drive innovation at scale, powered by bold thinking.
 



  





**Skills Required:** 




 Story Creation, Product Owner, Product Management, Backlog, Backlog Creation, User Stories, User Experience, Salesforce CRM, Salesforce Administration, Salesforce Flows, Apex (conceptual), API Integrations
 



  





**Experience Range:** 
 5 – 8 years
 



**About the Role:** 




 Product Owner (PO) — Salesforce Domain is a member of the extended Technical Product Management team and a crucial member of the Agile Team. PO owns the Team/Sprint backlog and is the single point of contact for the Dev team and business stakeholders for user story details within the Salesforce ecosystem (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Experience Cloud, and/or platform customizations).
 



  





 PO is responsible for defining and refining user stories for Salesforce configurations, automations, and integrations while prioritizing the Agile Team backlog to streamline execution of product priorities. PO drives story refinement ensuring the Team backlog contains 2 iterations of "ready" work. PO is also the only team member empowered to accept stories as Done.
 



  





**What You Will Do:** 




**Business and Technical Execution:** 



* Build and maintain Agile team backlog aligned to Salesforce platform roadmap and release windows
* Write and refine user stories and acceptance criteria for Salesforce configurations, automations (Flows, Apex), and integrations
* Review and prioritize team backlog for iteration planning; maintain 2 sprints of ready work
* Coordinate dependencies with other Product Owners, Salesforce Architects, Admins, and UI/UX teams
* Accept completed user stories ensuring Definition of Done including Salesforce quality standards (code coverage, governor limits, data compliance)
* Serve as single point of contact for Dev and business teams during sprints
* Create and review L3 diagrams, Swagger/OpenAPI specs for Salesforce REST integrations
* Drive Low\-Level/Domain\-Level Design for Salesforce platform features with Architects
* Review test cases and support QA during system, UAT, and night\-of\-release activities
* Participate in demos, retrospectives, PI planning, and Inspect \& Adapt workshops
* Conduct Platform\-Level Demos with stakeholders showcasing Salesforce features, reports, and dashboards
* Participate in and drive Salesforce release activities including deployment validation and smoke testing
* Run PO sync meetings in larger scaled ARTs and support Technical Product Manager with product vision and roadmap



  





**Relationship \& People, Professional Development:** 



* Build strong working relationships with Salesforce Admins, Architects, Developers, and business stakeholders
* Develop Salesforce platform training materials, release notes, and user manuals for stakeholders
* Contribute to Product Owner Community of Practice (COP) and Scrum Master Community of Practice
* Stay current with Salesforce product releases and incorporate relevant enhancements into the roadmap



  





**What You Will Bring:** 



* Bachelor's Degree (required)
* 4\+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Owner, Business Analyst, or System Analyst roles in Agile software development
* 2\+ years of hands\-on Salesforce platform experience (Admin, configuration, or development context)
* Strong understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud functional processes
* Experience writing user stories for Salesforce features: configurations, Flows, automation, and API integrations
* Strong technical writing, requirements elicitation, and communication skills
* Experience with Agile tools: Jira, Confluence, LucidChart, PlantUML, or VisioFamiliarity with Salesforce data model, object relationships, and SOQL conceptsStrong analytical skills and data\-driven decision\-making
* Scrum Product Owner certification (CSPO) – preferred
* Salesforce Certified Administrator or Platform App Builder – preferred



  





**Must Have Skills:** 



* Relevant Product Management, Product Owner, Business Analyst, or System Analyst experience in an Agile Salesforce product development environment. (Admin experience in salesforce domain)



  





**Nice To Have:** 



* Experience with Salesforce CPQ tool, Marketing Cloud, Experience Cloud, or Einstein Analytics. Familiarity with iPaaS integrations, JSON, API Swaggers, and L1/L2/L3 diagrams in a Salesforce context.

The PO works closely with the Development Team, Product Management, Professional Services, Technical Writers, and R\&D management.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Produce valuable content for our customers.
* Own the product backlog by deconstructing large features into smaller pieces, then defining and prioritizing them to compose a releasable product.
* Act as the central focal point for all internal and external parties on how the product works, its capabilities, and the effects of any changes.
* Analyze product business requirements and produce a functional design.
* Utilize deep knowledge of the product and its customer use cases to collaborate with R\&D, explain requirements, and answer functional questions.
* Lead large, high\-visibility projects that involve multiple development teams.


**Qualifications**
* 5\-8 years of experience as a functional analyst, product owner, business analyst, or in product management within the software industry.
* BTech, or BE in Computer Science/Engineering, or 3\-5 years of hands\-on experience in software development.
* Deep expertise in Digital Identity and Access Management (IAM), including protocols (OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, SAML 2\.0\), MFA, SCIM, SSO, federation, and access control models (RBAC/ABAC/PBAC/ReBAC).
* Proven technical skills and self\-learning ability, capable of thoroughly understanding the functional and technical aspects of IAM domains.
* Experience in writing functional designs.
* Proven Agile experience.
* Proven management skills.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Proactive, highly motivated individual with a serious work ethic and goal\-oriented approach.
* Innovative 'out of the box' thinker.
* Experience with an AI\-First strategy for initiatives.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Previous experience in a pre\-sale or post\-sale role.
* Information security experience.


**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

jobs.description:
**About Us**
 Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 As the ServiceNow HRSD Product Owner you are part of the People Digital Solutions team within People Digital. This role requires the unique skillset of someone who is a strategic thinker, a visionary, yet can translate that strategy and vision to an executable roadmap and plan. You lead a small team, and work as part of a larger Product, Adoption, Insights and Data Governance subject matter experts spread across the globe. You are required to assess business requirements, drive design discussions and decisions, set requirements and support implementation for your solution as required. You are responsible for coordinating, administering and governing the solution ongoing. You will ensure you are well informed as to the People, People Digital and Regions strategies when designing and enhancing your specific solution. You will believe that People digital solutions are an enabler of the culture and performance we want to create for our organisation, and you will be a thought leader in this space with a key focus on user experience. You will ensure the solution meets our regulatory, compliance, governance and ethical standards and effectively manage business risk. You will effectively collaborate with the Digital team, who have responsibility for configuration.

* In partnership with key stakeholders,

* Create project plans and structured methodologies and templates for your own work areas, and input into those owned by others

Minimum **5** year(s) of experience is required

In the role of Business Analyst, a typical day involves thoroughly examining the structure and operations of an organization to understand how its processes and systems function together. This includes evaluating the existing business model and how it aligns with technological solutions. The role requires identifying the current operational state, gathering detailed customer requirements, and envisioning an improved future state or business solution. The role is responsible for requirements gathering, analysis, and documentation for SharePoint\-based solutions, including the preparation of user stories and functional requirements to ensure that requirements are complete, actionable, and enable successful delivery.

* Support requirement gathering by engaging customers and stakeholders through calls, follow\-ups, review sessions, interviews, surveys, and document analysis.
* Capture, document, and organize business, functional, and process requirements for SharePoint\-based solutions, and prepare meeting notes, action trackers, and requirement summaries.

The team uses primarily Microsoft SharePoint (on\-prem and cloud) as a platform. We use various web development and automation tools and technologies within a structured delivery process to develop products that deliver significant value to our internal customers across Deloitte’s global network.

**Location: Hyderabad**

**Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM**

**Qualifications**


Required:

* 1\-2 years of experience in business analysis, requirements gathering, or scope documentation
* Experience documenting business, functional, and process requirements
* Experience drafting user stories, acceptance criteria, and backlog items
* Experience using Azure DevOps or a similar tool for backlog, sprint, and defect tracking

================

**About the Role**


The Transformation Analyst will be part of the Transformation Management Office, focused on driving transformation across the enterprise. This role requires a professional with hands\-on experience in finance process redesign, forecasting model development, performance reporting and transformation. The incumbent will work closely with Finance leadership and TMO colleagues to help transform existing finance processes, design improved workflows, and support the implementation of scalable forecasting and planning capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the design and execution of transformation initiatives covering processes, systems, and reporting
* Analyse existing finance workflows (budgeting, forecasting, close processes, management reporting) to identify inefficiencies and improvement opportunities
* Build and refine financial forecasting models, scenario analyses, and planning frameworks in collaboration with Finance and Business teams
* Prepare transformation progress reports, dashboards, and executive updates for finance workstreams
* Track workstream milestones, dependencies, and risks; escalate issues proactively
* Collaborate with Finance, FP\&A, Controllership, and other functions to drive cross\-functional alignment on transformation priorities
* Assist in building business cases and quantifying the value impact of transformation initiatives
* Contribute to TMO governance, reporting cadences, and knowledge management
**Required Qualifications**

* MBA (Finance) or CA / CMA / CFA; engineering undergraduate degree preferred
* 2–6 years of experience in finance transformation, FP\&A, management consulting (finance practice), or corporate finance roles
* Solid understanding of core finance processes: budgeting, forecasting, financial close, management reporting, and variance analysis
* Hands\-on experience building financial models, forecasts, and scenario analyses in Excel or equivalent tools
* Ability to map and redesign business processes; familiarity with process mapping tools or methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma basics)
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to work with large datasets and derive actionable insights
* Clear, concise communication skills — ability to prepare structured decks, memos, and progress reports for senior audiences
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, ambiguous environment with multiple parallel workstreams
* Proficiency in Excel (advanced), PowerPoint, and data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent)
* Experience in value tracking — quantifying benefits realized from process changes and reporting against committed targets
* Understanding of how finance transformation connects to broader enterprise P\&L and working capital outcomes
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience in Big 4 consulting (finance transformation / advisory practice) or consulting firms
* Exposure to finance transformation in technology, manufacturing, or infrastructure sectors
**Core Competencies**

* Finance Process Analysis \& Redesign
* Financial Modelling \& Forecasting
* Data Analysis \& Visualization
* Structured Problem Solving
* Stakeholder Communication
* Programme Tracking \& Reporting
* Business Case Development
* Cross\-functional Collaboration
* Process Mapping \& Improvement
* Transformation Delivery Support
**Why Join Us**


This role offers a unique opportunity to sit at the intersection of Finance and Transformation, working directly with finance leadership and the TMO on high\-impact initiatives. You will gain enterprise\-wide visibility into how the firm evolves, with hands\-on experience driving measurable process improvements and building forecasting capabilities that inform strategic decisions.

Employee

### **Product Manager**

**Who are we?**



Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

  


A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.



A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
**Job Summary**



We're building HR and Legal data products that power workforce planning, talent strategy, compliance, and risk management across the enterprise. These products unify data from core systems (HRIS/HCM, ATS, contract lifecycle, and compliance tooling) and are delivered through a unified enterprise analytics and intelligence platform—a trusted single source of reference that exposes insight through APIs, semantic models, dashboards, and conversational and agentic AI experiences.



As Product Manager, you'll help drive the data \& analytics product strategy and roadmap for our Corporate Functions (HR and Legal). You'll partner closely with stakeholders to understand their strategic priorities, operating rhythms (talent review cycles, workforce planning cadence, compliance calendars, contract renewals), and pain points—fragmented data, manual reporting, limited scenario planning, and governance gaps—and translate them into high\-impact, AI\-enabled data products that increase insight precision, automate reporting, and elevate HR and Legal as strategic advisors to the business.



**Responsibilities**


* Partner \& advise: Build trusted relationships with HR and Legal stakeholders by understanding their objectives, operating cadence, and core processes; translate pain points (attrition risk, headcount reconciliation, skills and talent gaps, DEI reporting, contract bottlenecks, compliance governance) into data product solutions. Manage stakeholder expectations within and across functions
* Shape strategy \& roadmap: Support development of the product strategy and an ROI\-informed roadmap, balancing quick\-win delivery with foundational platform efforts
* Build data products: Contribute to function\-grade semantic models (employee, talent, headcount, contract, compliance) that integrate with the enterprise platform, its model store, and query APIs. Help productize analytics and AI/ML services—workforce forecasting, talent dashboards, compliance reporting packs, conversational insights, governance\-enabled data catalogs—while upholding platform principles: system of reference (not system of record), domain data ownership, and full lineage, provenance, and auditability
* Analyze the market: Research industry practices, competitors, and verticals; report on emerging HR and Legal analytics and AI trends (predictive attrition modeling, skills intelligence, contract analytics, compliance automation). Introduce best\-in\-class external practices and governance frameworks (GDPR, data privacy, records compliance)
* Develop business cases: Collaborate on—and may create—financial business models; conduct business opportunity reviews with senior team members
* Measure success: Define metrics that inform product success and drive user experience improvements (adoption, reporting cycle\-time reduction, forecast accuracy, model quality, automation ROI)
* Collaborate cross\-functionally: Work closely with data platform, data science, AI/ML, and engineering teams; support backlog refinement, test case definition and UAT, and design product training curriculum


**Qualifications**


* 7\+ years of experience preferred, ideally with exposure to HR and/or Legal data products
* Bachelor's degree preferred, ideally in Statistics, Data Science, Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field
* Familiarity with modern enterprise data platforms, semantic/data modeling, APIs, and AI/ML concepts; experience delivering products on an analytics/intelligence platform is a strong plus
* Understanding of data governance principles—lineage, provenance, auditability, and domain data ownership
* Knowledge of HR and/or Legal concepts (workforce planning, talent management, people analytics, compliance, data privacy, contract lifecycle management) is a strong plus
* Excellent communicator who can simplify the complex and build trusted relationships with business stakeholders
* Ability to work across HR, Legal, IT, Engineering, Data Science, and AI/ML teams
* Bias for action, ownership, and the ability to break down complex problems, drive alignment, and remain decisive

jobs.title: Senior Analyst - Business
jobs.description:
The Product Operations Support role is a core member of the Product Management team, responsible for enabling Product Managers to operate more effectively by owning key operational, administrative, and coordination activities. This role focuses on ensuring that product work is clearly defined, well\-documented, and ready for execution before entering Engineering, QA, or other delivery teams. By maintaining documentation quality, backlog hygiene, and cross\-functional coordination, Product Operations Support allows Product Managers to focus on strategy, discovery, customer engagement, and decision\-making. In addition, the role supports informed product decisions by contributing to market research and customer experience to flesh out feature specifications. This includes gathering and synthesizing insights from usage data, support trends, sales input, and customer feedback to help identify patterns, opportunities, and areas of improvement for Product Manager review. This is a hands\-on, detail\-oriented role suited to someone who enjoys bringing structure to complex or ambiguous product work, working with both qualitative and quantitative inputs, and who takes pride in high\-quality execution.  

  



**Responsibilities:**

**Product Requirements \& Documentation**

* Draft and maintain clear, structured product documentation based on Product Manager direction and team discussions, including:
	+ Problem statements and objectives
	+ User stories and acceptance criteria
	+ Assumptions, constraints, and dependencies
* Attend product discovery, refinement, and planning sessions, capturing decisions, actions, and open questions
* Ensure requirements are complete, consistent, and actionable before work is handed to Engineering or QA

**Backlog \& Tooling Management**

* Prepare, draft, and maintain work items in the product backlog (e.g. YouTrack), ensuring:
	+ Sufficient context and scope
	+ Clearly defined acceptance criteria
	+ Appropriate categorisation, prioritisation, and linking
* Perform regular backlog hygiene activities, identifying stale, incomplete, or mis\-scoped items
* Proactively flag risks, gaps, or missing information to Product Managers before work progresses

**Issue Triage \& First\-Pass Analysis**

* Perform first\-pass triage of incoming issues, feature requests, and defects by:
	+ Reproducing issues where possible
	+ Confirming scope, impact, and affected products or versions
	+ Ensuring issues are clearly described and ready for technical review
* Escalate complex, ambiguous, or high\-risk items to Product Managers with clear summaries and recommended next steps

**Product Operations \& Coordination**

* Support product planning and delivery activities, including:
	+ Maintaining source\-of\-truth planning artefacts and roadmaps
	+ Supporting release, and milestone planning
	+ Tracking actions and follow\-ups from product\-related meetings
* Assist with internal product communications by preparing structured inputs for launch, release, or change communications

**Insights, Feedback \& Continuous Improvement**

* Consolidate product feedback from multiple sources, including Support, Sales, Customer Success, and internal teams
* Organise feedback into clear themes and insights for Product Manager review
* Identify recurring operational friction points and suggest improvements to product processes, templates, or tooling.
* Works with project managers and user experience analysts to facilitate requirements sessions or interviews with customers, business partners, and cross\-functional team members to justify a business case.
* Based on requirements, develops user stories, activity diagrams, other detailed requirements documents, plans for delivery, and plans to monitor and measure the impact.
* Collaborates with technical counterparts in information technology and development resources to create and validate business requirements and project specification documents.
* Works with user experience analysts, teammates, and development teams to produce high\-fidelity prototypes, research, and functionality demos.
* Presents functional requirements to development, UX, quality assurance, and technical architecture teams, and represents stakeholders while addressing technical questions throughout the agile iterations.
* Works with quality assurance analysts to create test plans and/or execution test scenarios to support requirements validation, user acceptance testing (UAT) and system testing.
Provides mentorship and guidance to less experienced analysts.  
* 

**Qualifications:**

* 4\-7 years’ experience in Assistant Product Owner Role part of core member of the Product Management team, responsible for enabling Product Managers to operate more effectively by owning key operational, administrative, and coordination activities.
* PMO, Program Operations, Portfolio Operations, Delivery Governance, PMO Systems Administration, or similar operational delivery roles.
* Strong written communication skills, particularly for technical or semi\-technical documentation
* High attention to detail with the ability to structure ambiguous information clearly
* Experience working with issue tracking, backlog management, or project management tools
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders
* Support Product Managers by preparing, maintaining, and improving product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Manage and maintain product backlogs to ensure work is well\-scoped, prioritized, and ready for delivery
* Perform first\-pass triage and analysis of issues, defects, and feature requests before escalation
* Contribute to market, competitive, and customer research activities to support informed product decisions
* Analyse product data and customer feedback to identify trends, insights, and improvement opportunities
* Coordinate across Product, Engineering, QA, and go\-to\-market teams to support effective product planning and delivery

jobs.description:
**About Plum**  

  



Plum is an employee insurance and health benefits platform focused on making health insurance simple, accessible and inclusive for modern organizations. Healthcare in India is seeing a phenomenal shift with inflation in healthcare costs 3x that of general inflation. A majority of Indians are unable to afford health insurance on their own; and so as many as 600mn Indians will likely have to depend on employer\-sponsored insurance. Plum is on a mission to provide the highest quality insurance and healthcare to 10 million lives by FY2030, through companies that care. Plum is backed by Tiger Global and Peak XV Partners.


**About the Role**


We're looking for a Technical Program Lead – Insurance Partnerships to help scale Plum's insurer ecosystem. In this role, you'll own the end\-to\-end execution of insurer integrations, working at the intersection of technology, product, and business. You'll partner with insurance companies, engineering, product, and operations teams to deliver seamless API integrations, drive strategic initiatives, and improve how Plum collaborates with its insurer partners.


If you enjoy solving complex integration challenges, managing cross\-functional programs, and working with multiple stakeholders, we'd love to meet you.


**What You'll Do**


**Lead Technical Integrations**


* Own end\-to\-end integration of insurer systems with Plum's platform through APIs and data exchange.
* Partner closely with Engineering and Product teams to plan, implement, test, and troubleshoot integrations.
* Drive successful onboarding of new insurance partners while ensuring high\-quality technical execution.
* Identify opportunities to improve existing integrations, automate workflows, and enhance partner experience.

**Drive Strategic Partnerships**


* Work closely with leadership on strategic initiatives across insurer partnerships.
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for insurer integration programs.
* Align internal Product, Engineering, Operations, and Partnership teams to ensure successful execution.
* Build scalable processes that improve collaboration and operational efficiency across partner ecosystems.

**Program \& Project Management**


* Plan and manage multiple integration programs simultaneously.
* Define project plans, milestones, timelines, and success metrics.
* Identify dependencies, risks, and implementation bottlenecks, and proactively drive resolution.
* Coordinate with external insurer teams to ensure timely delivery and successful launches.
* Track program progress, communicate updates to stakeholders, and ensure alignment with business goals.

**What We're Looking For**


* **3–6 years** of experience in Technical Program Management, Technical Project Management, Solutions Engineering, or Implementation roles.
* Experience managing **API integrations**, system implementations, or enterprise technical projects.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, data exchange, integration workflows, and technical documentation.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate across Engineering, Product, Business, and external partners.
* Strong program management, planning, and execution capabilities.
* Exceptional problem\-solving and communication skills.

**Preferred**


* Experience in **Insurance, InsurTech, FinTech, SaaS, or enterprise platform integrations**.

**Why Join Plum?**


* Build the technology that powers partnerships with India's leading insurers.
* Work on large\-scale API integrations that directly impact millions of users.
* Collaborate with high\-performing Product, Engineering, and Business teams.
* Own high\-impact programs with significant visibility and autonomy.

* Help redefine how health insurance is delivered for modern workplaces.

jobs.title: Data & AI Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Data \& AI Product Manager** 




  





 Job Location:
 



  





**The role** 




 This role exists at the intersection of a technically complex AI system and a commercial market that is still learning what it will pay for. As Data and AI Product Manager you will define what Driivz's data and AI capabilities look like as products that operators buy \-\- the packaging, the pricing logic, the proof\-of\-value framework, and the commercial conversation that converts a pilot into a contract.
 



  





 You are not a scrum master and you are not a backlog prioritiser. You are the person who understands what operators will pay for before the team builds it, designs the commercial model that makes the product a business, and manages the pilot operators whose experience generates the proof points that make the next sale possible. You work from India but you spend significant time in commercial conversations with operators across multiple geographies.
 



  





**What you will own** 




**Product and commercial** 



* AI product scope and packaging: what gets built into a discrete product that operators pay for, in what tiers, at what price points
* Commercial model design: the pricing logic that connects the value Driivz generates for operators to a fee structure that is fair, credible, and scalable
* Proof\-of\-value framework: the structure of pilot periods including baseline measurement, tracked metrics, and conversion logic \-\- the 90\-day pilot must make the commercial decision obvious, not require a separate sales effort
* Guardrail framework: translating operator preferences for AI decision boundaries into documented product configuration requirements for the engineering team



  





**Customer and market** 



* Pilot operator management: running the proof periods of the first 3 to 5 operator pilots from connection to contract
* Operator discovery: 5 or more structured discovery conversations per quarter with operator ops directors and commercial leadership \-\- understanding what they will pay for before building it
* GTM with CS and commercial: translating AI system capabilities into the language and framing that closes a conversation with a CFO or COO
* External operator pipeline: identifying and engaging operators outside Driivz's existing customer base who are candidates for standalone AI product adoption



  





  





**What we are looking for** 




**Non\-negotiable** 



* You have taken a data or AI product to market \-\- not internal tooling, not a feature within a larger product, but a discrete product that external customers evaluated, negotiated, and paid for.
* You have designed a commercial model for a product where value is variable and outcome\-linked. You understand the difference between value\-based pricing and cost\-plus pricing and can explain when each is appropriate.
* You have run commercial discovery conversations at VP or C\-suite level \-\- not just with product users or technical stakeholders. You understand how a CFO evaluates a data product differently from how an ops director does.
* You can build a financial case from operational data. The commercial conversation for this product requires translating system performance metrics into an operator P\&L impact that a CFO will accept.



  





**Strong signal** 



* EV, energy, smart grid, infrastructure, or industrial IoT sector product experience
* SLA\-based or outcome\-linked commercial model experience: contracts where payment depends on measured performance
* Cross\-geography commercial experience: operator conversations spanning different regulatory environments and commercial cultures
* Technical credibility: able to explain what the AI system does without misrepresenting it \-\- CPOs ask hard questions and will not sign contracts with someone who does not understand the product
* Proof period design: has structured a time\-limited pilot that produced a clear, data\-backed commercial decision at the end



  





**This role is not right for you if** 



* You have only managed internal product roadmaps or feature backlogs. This role requires commercial ownership \-\- pricing decisions, contract terms, and the revenue that comes from signed contracts.
* You have not had commercial conversations with CFO or COO\-level buyers. The product conversation for AI systems that affect operational costs and revenues happens at a different level than typical product discovery.
* You cannot explain the difference between a managed fee and a performance\-based commercial model, or when each is the right choice for an operator in a specific situation.

We are looking for Infrastructure Platform Engineers. The ideal candidate will own and manage everything below the application layer, including compute infrastructure, container orchestration, RAG pipelines, CI/CD, observability, load testing, and security.


The candidate should have strong experience building, deploying, and operating production\-grade AI and LLM platforms. * 1 Onsite resource.

* Deploy and maintain RAG pipeline infrastructure and GPU\-based AI workloads.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and GitOps practices.

* Drive InfoSec compliance, security reviews, and infrastructure governance.

* Hands\-on experience supporting production services with SLAs, incident management, on\-call rotations, and post\-mortem analysis.

Container Orchestration \& Runtime

Cloud Platforms


Required: Azure


Preferred: AWS

Infrastructure as Code

AI / ML Infrastructure

CI/CD and Deployment

Observability and Monitoring

Performance, Security \& FinOps

jobs.description:
Job Description:
**Role Title**  

**DCX AI Business Analyst**  

**Exp \- 8\-10 yrs****Location \- Bangalore (Hybrid)**  

Role Summary  

We are looking for a Business Analyst to support the DCX AI journey by translating business problems into clear, actionable AI use cases, requirements, value cases and implementation\-ready specifications. The ideal candidate is a business\-first, AI\-curious analyst who can operate between strategy and execution. The person should be comfortable working with ambiguity, asking sharp questions, structuring unclear business problems, and converting ideas into actionable AI use cases.  

The role will work closely with domain owners, digital product teams, AI Hub / architecture teams, low\-code makers, data teams, Enterprise IT, security/privacy stakeholders, and the DCX AI Office to identify, shape, prioritize and govern AI initiatives across customer\-facing digital capabilities.  

This role is not a traditional requirements\-only BA role. The person must be able to identify new AI trends related to Customer Experience, connect business value, process understanding, data readiness, AI feasibility, responsible AI, governance, adoption and ROI into one structured delivery approach.
Context of the Role  

DCX is accelerating its transition toward an AI\-enabled and Agentic AI\-driven customer experience organization. The DCX AI strategy focuses on building a unified AI strategy, developing an AI use\-case portfolio, governing a centralized agent registry, and accelerating Agentic AI deployment across customer\-facing capabilities.  

This BA role will help operationalize the AI economics model by ensuring AI use cases are well\-defined, value\-backed, measurable, governed and ready for execution and track the Cost effectiveness,
Key Responsibilities  

1\. AI Use Case Discovery \& Intake  

* Partner with DCX domains, product owners, business stakeholders and AI Office leads to identify AI, Agentic AI and automation opportunities.
* Capture business problems, current pain points, user journeys, operational inefficiencies and customer impact.
* Structure AI use cases into a standard intake format covering problem statement, business owner, expected value, target users, process scope, data sources, dependencies and success criteria.
* Support the centralized AI use\-case and agent registry for DCX.
* Help assess whether a use case is suitable for off\-the\-shelf AI, low\-code agent, Copilot Studio, AI Hub / pro\-code solution, vendor AI capability or process redesign.


2\. Requirements \& Process Analysis  

* Translate business goals into actionable AI requirements, user stories, process flows and functional specifications.
* Document current\-state and future\-state process flows for AI\-enabled workflows.
* Identify manual handoffs, repetitive decisions, knowledge bottlenecks, data gaps and automation candidates.
* Define human\-in\-the\-loop requirements, approval points, exception handling and fallback processes.
* Work with AI architects and technical teams to convert business needs into AI\-ready solution requirements.


The need for this type of BA capability is aligned with the broader AI project role view where business analysts translate business goals into actionable plans.
3\. AI Value, KPI \& Business Case Support  

* Define expected value for each AI use case across adoption, productivity, business value, customer experience, risk and ROI.
* Build initial business cases including expected time savings, cost avoidance, revenue uplift, case deflection, NSS impact or process acceleration where applicable.
* Support the AI Value Scorecard for each use case.
* Track KPI baselines, targets and realized outcomes after pilot or production launch.
* Work with Finance / AI Economics stakeholders to support cost/benefit tracking, forecast vs actual analysis, cost per interaction, cost per outcome and ROI.


4\. AI Governance \& Lifecycle Support  

* Ensure each AI use case follows the agreed lifecycle from idea, discovery, POC, pilot, scale and operations.
* Support governance gates by validating that required information is complete before moving to the next stage.
* Maintain documentation for ownership, budget owner, data sources, risk classification, security/privacy status, responsible AI status and operational readiness.
* Help prepare decision packs for DCX AIX Office, DCR AI Ops, CXCT Transformation and leadership reviews.
* Support governance rhythm and portfolio reporting.

5\. Responsible AI \& Risk Awareness  

* Support Responsible AI assessment for AI use cases, especially around privacy, security, safety, reliability and accountability.
* Identify risks related to data usage, customer impact, automation decisions, agent autonomy, hallucination, bias, security and process control.
* Work with Security / Privacy / Responsible AI stakeholders to ensure the required checks are completed.
* Ensure AI use cases have clear human accountability and escalation paths.


6\. Stakeholder \& Change Enablement  

* Act as a bridge between business teams, digital teams, AI Hub, Enterprise IT, security/privacy, finance and delivery teams.
* Facilitate workshops to define AI opportunities, requirements, process redesign and value hypotheses.
* Help business users understand how AI can improve workflows and customer experience.
* Support adoption planning, user readiness, training inputs and feedback collection.
* Capture lessons learned and help convert pilots into reusable patterns.


Key Deliverables  

The AI Business Analyst will be expected to produce and maintain:  

* AI use\-case intake forms
* Business problem statements
* Current\-state and future\-state process maps
* AI opportunity assessments
* User stories and functional requirements
* AI feasibility and value assessment
* Business case and ROI assumptions
* KPI definition and AI Value Scorecard inputs
* Data source and dependency mapping
* Risk and Responsible AI assessment inputs

jobs.title: Channel Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

The Channel Operations Analyst is a critical operational role within the Channel Sales organization, responsible for ensuring the seamless onboarding, enablement, and ongoing productivity of our partner ecosystem. This individual serves as the operational backbone of the channel program \- bridging systems, processes, and people to drive partner activation, engagement, and revenue performance.


The ideal candidate is detail\-oriented, process\-driven, and comfortable working cross\-functionally across Sales, Legal, Finance, Marketing, and BI teams. They bring a strong command of GTM systems (Salesforce, Odoo, PRM platforms), a data\-first mindset, and a passion for building scalable partner experiences.

  

  

  

**Core Responsibilities**

**1\. Partner Onboarding**

* Review and process new partner applications daily within established SLAs (\<24\-hour turnaround).


* Coordinate account creation and validation across GTM systems including Salesforce and Odoo.


* Collaborate with Channel Sales, Legal, and Finance teams to facilitate required partner documentation and due diligence.


* Maintain and continuously improve partner application process documentation; identify automation and efficiency opportunities.


* Track and report on onboarding SLAs, conversion rates, and partner activation metrics.

  

  

**2\. Partner Enablement**

**Operational Readiness**

* Train partners on PRM workflows including deal registration, NFR license requests, certification completion, resource library access, and marketing asset utilization.


* Create and maintain operational enablement materials — guides, videos, and FAQs — in collaboration with Channel Marketing and Learning Management teams.


* Manage the PRM knowledge base and partner\-facing communications for all operational updates.


**System Operations**

* Serve as the functional tester for all GTM system updates impacting the Channel organization.


* Validate partner experience, workflow consistency, and data integrity throughout UAT cycles.


* Document test outcomes and coordinate issue resolution with relevant system admins and product owners.

  

  

**3\. Channel Productivity**

* Track and report partner engagement and transaction metrics including deal registrations, ACV, and active reseller counts.


* Identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies within partner processes; provide actionable recommendations for automation and/or targeted training in collaboration with Sales Enablement.


* Support the expansion of deal\-to\-onboarding workflows and post\-win enablement initiatives.

  

  

**4\. Channel Reporting**

* Ensure accuracy and integrity of partner data across Salesforce, PRM, and Odoo.


* Own the reporting cadence for partner tiers, productivity and enablement KPIs, and onboarding SLA performance.


* Collaborate with BI teams to refine reporting frameworks, dashboards, and partner productivity visualizations.


* Proactively escalate data quality issues and emerging trends to relevant stakeholders.

  

  

  

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 2–4 years of experience in channel operations, sales operations, or partner program management.


* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce CRM; exposure to Odoo or similar ERP platforms is a strong plus.


* Experience working with Partner Relationship Management (PRM) platforms (e.g. Salesforce PRM, or similar).


* Strong analytical skills with the ability to build and interpret reports, dashboards, and KPIs.


* Excellent organizational skills; ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.


* Strong cross\-functional communication and collaboration skills.


* High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and process consistency.

  

  

**Preferred**

* Experience in a SaaS or technology company channel environment.


* Familiarity with partner enablement content development (training guides, FAQs, video walkthroughs).


* Exposure to UAT processes and working alongside system administrators or product teams.


* Proficiency with BI tools such as Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms.


* Understanding of channel partner tiers, deal registration processes, and reseller dynamics.

If you are a driven, creative and collaborative individual, with exceptional technology skills to drive innovation, we want to hear from you.

* The ideal candidate is not just a backlog manager or delivery coordinator. We are looking for someone who can understand complex healthcare workflows, identify the real customer and business problems, define clear product outcomes, collaborate deeply with engineering and cross\-functional teams, and drive measurable impact.

The Product Manager will be expected to own outcomes from discovery through delivery, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.

* Define clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, workflow documentation, and decision records.
* Ensure requirements are complete, testable, and traceable, including assumptions, dependencies, open questions, edge cases, risks, and validation expectations.
* Work with engineering, QA, design, data, and operations teams to identify feasibility concerns, implementation risks, downstream impacts, and support needs early.
* Ensure stories and epics are ready for development with clear scope, business context, success criteria, and validation approach.
* Avoid jumping directly to features; focus first on the root problem, desired outcome, and evidence needed to support the decision.


**Payment Accuracy Workflow \& Product Execution**
* Own product capabilities related to payment accuracy workflows such as claim validation, edit/rule logic, requirements intake, configuration workflows, operational tooling, analytics enablement, and customer\-value measurement.
* Improve the clarity, consistency, and scalability of how payment accuracy capabilities are defined, built, launched, supported, and measured.
* Help reduce dependency on manual processes, tribal knowledge, duplicate logic, and one\-off customisation.
* Drive product decisions that improve speed to value, repeatability, reliability, and customer confidence.
* Partner with engineering and QA to ensure edge cases, exceptions, failure scenarios, and validation needs are well understood before release.
* Support continuous improvement of workflows after launch based on usage data, stakeholder feedback, customer outcomes, and operational learnings.

**WHO YOU ARE** 
  

 We are looking for a Business Analyst – GBO Support to join us in developing ways for IKEA to stay relevant for our customers.

 Passionate about understanding complex business processes, the strategic impact of digital tools on operational excellence, and how digital systems can optimize them.
   

 Have a strong background in business analysis, IT operations, data\-driven problem solving, and driving digital transformation initiatives in collaboration with functions like AMS, Enterprise Architecture, and Digital Platforms.
   

 Love being creative through identifying opportunities for efficiency, automation, and continuous improvement using digital solutions.
   

 Take ownership and independently drive towards desired outcomes
   

 Know about developing strategic roadmaps for IT enablement, operational optimization through digital tools, and effective collaboration frameworks across digital functions.
   

 Have experience working in cross\-functional teams, bridging the gap between business and IT stakeholders.
   

 Are a team player who takes ownership, builds cross\-functional relationships with peers and loves sharing knowledge with others
   

 Proactively manage relevant stakeholders
   

 Are curious, self\-directed and want to keep learning!
   

  

 This is our wish list! If you don’t recognize yourself in all these points, you might still be an excellent candidate for the role.
   

 The must\-haves we see for this role is though:
   

  

 Proven experience as a Business Analyst with a strong focus on IT systems, operational efficiency, and digital transformation.
   

 Strong analytical skills, with the ability to gather, interpret, and present data to identify bottlenecks, opportunities for optimization, and the impact of digital solutions.
   

 Demonstrated ability to establish and manage governance processes that rigorously track the impact of IT incidents and system performance on Global Business Operations (GBO) Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), driving accountability and continuous operational improvement
   

  

 The IKEA culture and values are very much a part of our business and day\-to\-day work life. For you to thrive and grow with IKEA it’s important for us that you share our values! You can read more about our values and life at IKEA on our website www.ikea.com.
   

  

**A DAY IN YOUR LIFE WITH US** 
  

 You’ll be a vital part in the transformation of IKEA into a more front line obsessed company by ensuring that Global Business Operations are seamlessly powered by digital innovation, leading to a low\-cost, agile, and customer\-centric IKEA experience.
   

  

 This mean that you will:
   

  

 Partner closely with the GBO function to deeply understand existing operational processes, digital system utilization, and identify opportunities for optimization and digital tool adoption.
   

 Gather and analyse data from various sources to identify IT\-related bottlenecks and areas where digital systems can be leveraged for greater operational efficiency and cost savings.
   

 Bridge the gap between business needs and IT capabilities, translating GBO requirements into actionable IT solutions and improvements, actively collaborating with Digital Functions like AMS, Enterprise Architecture, and Digital Platforms.
   

 Design, implement, and run a governance framework to track the impact of IT incidents, digital tool implementations, and operational improvements on GBO KPIs and overall business value.
   

 Proactively identify, evaluate, and propose automation opportunities and new digital tools within existing GBO processes to drive significant operational efficiency and cost benefits for the company.
   

  

**TOGETHER AS A TEAM** 
  

 We see ourselves as influencers – we steer the IKEA business by finding the truth behind the figures. Together we secure compliance with local and international laws and reporting standards; we assure that accounting processes are efficient and that tax compliance meets business needs. We’re a diverse group of people driven by providing reliable financial data to a wide variety of stakeholders. At the end of the day, that’s one of the foundations to make IKEA even better!

 **strong business analysis skills, product thinking, domain modelling, systems thinking,** 
 and AI\-assisted analysis to discover requirements, define product behavior, and enable rapid product delivery.

 **understanding customer journeys, analyzing complex business domains, documenting functional and non\-functional requirements, modelling business processes, and collaborating across product, engineering, architecture, and AI teams.** 
 We are looking for analysts who can effectively use AI as a force multiplier to accelerate research, documentation, requirement analysis, and product discovery while ensuring business accuracy and completeness.
 



  





**Experience level** 
 : 5 to 10 years
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Product Discovery:** 



* Work closely with Product Managers, customers, domain experts, and engineering teams to discover business problems and identify product opportunities.

* Customer Journey Mapping
* AI\-assisted Product Discovery
* Design Thinking
* Systems Thinking

* Improve requirement quality, reducing ambiguity and downstream rework.
